positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Support production printing systems and R&D operations through debugging, feature development, and real‑time issue resolution
• Assumed ownership of existing RTOS code for the print chamber and gas‑recirculation system, maintaining, extending, and debugging real‑time control functionality
• Coordinate behavior between HMI processes and RTOS tasks to ensure stable, predictable control of printer subsystems

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained industrial HMI applications in .NET/C# for both legacy and next‑generation printing systems
• Implemented control‑layer software for laser instrumentation, including power supplies, pulsers, and beam shapers
• Built communication interfaces and programming logic for real‑time coordination between HMI and hardware devices
• Diagnosed and resolved production system bugs, providing real‑time support for active printing operations
• Improved reliability and automation across manufacturing workflows through targeted software enhancements
• Collaborated with controls, hardware, and manufacturing teams to deliver stable, operator‑friendly HMI functionality

positions.title: Senior Test Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed configurable HMI systems for the Field Replaceable Unit Assembly Area, enabling one codebase to support multiple FRU types
• Supported software/controls for the FRU Assembly Area clean room (lasers & optics)
• Automated test workflows and ensured assemblies were loaded with correct software and configuration
• Designed mechanical test fixtures and integrated manufacturing devices
• Procured and validated equipment for technicians and production workflows
• Authored targeted work instructions to support assembly and test operations

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Develop synchronized multi-processor edge device for the solar industry using Arm Cortex-M and 8051 microcontrollers
• Select and procure microcontrollers for solar industry products based on hardware design requirements
• Bring-up PCBs using custom drivers to interface with on-chip peripherals such as ADC, DAC, DMA, GPIO, PWM, SPI, timers, and UART with C language
• Write maintainable and efficient firmware that aligns with product specifications in a bare metal environment
• Utilize control registers to achieve desired function of microcontroller and monitor status registers to verify intended states during crucial processes such as interrupt service routines
• Debug during PCB bring-up and firmware development using SWD and C2 debuggers, oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analyzers, and custom WinForms tools
• Create custom in-application bootloaders to enable field updates over RS485
• Devise and program automated production test software which interfaces with DMMs, power supplies, solar test equipment, and DUTs using WinForms with C# language
• Develop multi-threaded applications which enable the customer to view real-time data generated from the product, configure Modbus communication and device-specific settings, calibrate the devices via simple procedures, and update firmware
• Support customers that are actively troubleshooting issues in the field with technical knowledge and prowess
positions.insights: Skills: C# · WinForms · C (Programming Language) · Embedded Systems · .NET Framework · 8051 Microcontroller · ARM Cortex-M

positions.title: MWD Field Engineer
positions.description:
• Configured and calibrated MWD hardware to enable proper functionality which decreased tool failures
• Programmed MWD tool with optimal data rate and sequence which decreased drilling time
• Operated and monitored Noralis software to proactively identify issues and troubleshoot abnormalities which minimized shutdown time and reduced expenses

positions.title: Field Service Technician II
positions.description:
• Managed field office tool inventory and efficiently installed and operated specialty tools at customer sites which led to customer satisfaction and repeat sales
• Facilitated sales by traveling to sites and explaining technical details of downhole tools to client

positions.description: • Provided customer added-value through the application of accurate calculations, specification of efficient project designs, and development of comprehensive technical documents
